# JS Function

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A JavaScript function any expression can call by name, run by DuckDB per row. For logic the expression language has no words for; it returns a number, or an array of `width` numbers. Prefer an expression where one will do: DuckDB runs JS some 20 times slower than SQL.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "js-function", "name": "js-function", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

A parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:width`, or read elsewhere as `ch('js-function/width')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
